signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI (powered by Anthropic's Claude) for its GRC platform and was named top-ranked in Info-Tech's 2025 GRC Data Quadrant.

email.body1:
Jessee, saw Onspring launch Onspring AI and top Info-Tech's 2025 GRC Data Quadrant.

Shipping AI and earning that ranking usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where enterprise deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jessee, quick follow-up for Onspring.

With new AI capabilities driving demand, the enterprise pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover. Most directors cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Onspring needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jessee, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to other GRC-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jessee, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product-launch stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Onspring either way.
